column1: # ŌKAMI HD 1.0.0 (base game), SDK 4, NVN with CRIWARE.
# 2026-11-26: AYN Odin 2, Adreno 740, Android 13, Turnip (KIMCHI turnip v26.0.0_R8: Mesa 26.0.0-devel, packed with --vulkan-driver). 30 fps, as on the Switch.
# The Celestial Brush drawn by touch vanished while the finger was still down: the game's touch reader (main 0x747c) keeps a held finger only while more than 8 of
# the newest GetTouchScreenStates entries hold it, and the host handed back 1 entry. 16 entries repeat the newest state (hle_hid.c touch_states_read)
# Brush strokes were never recognized (the Tachigami Power Slash at the first statue, by touch or with the stick): on entering brush mode the game copies its
# 256x256 scene into a LINEAR texture (nvn format 0x9a, stride 1024) and reads the stroke from that storage on the CPU. Without the copy-back
# (gfx_vk_exec_copies.inc t2t_lin_back) the CPU read an empty picture and refused every stroke
